```python
# filename: earliest_bluray_preview.py
import pandas as pd
fp = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/32102e3e-d12a-4209-9163-7b3a104efe5d.xlsx'

df['Format'] = df['Title'].where(df['Title'].isin(markers)).ffill()
items = df[~df['Title'].isin(markers)].copy()
bluray = items[items['Format'] == 'Blu-Ray'].copy()
bluray['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(bluray['Year'], errors='coerce')
bluray = bluray.dropna(subset=['Year'])
bluray_sorted = bluray.sort_values(by='Year', ascending=True)
print(bluray_sorted[['Title','Year']].head(5))
# Choose the earliest from this preview
earliest_title = bluray_sorted.iloc[0]['Title'] if not bluray_sorted.empty else None
print('Earliest (preview):', earliest_title)
```
